differences.a_observable: Camera is close to the card with a steep angle and shallow depth of field, blurring background.
differences.b_observable: Camera is further away with a flatter angle and deep depth of field, keeping background sharp.
differences.fix: Adjust camera distance, tilt, and enable shallow depth of field.
